scope: Publication selection, local links, build evidence and artifact integrity; not an exhaustive security audit or field validation.
credential_scan_scope: UTF-8 newly staged files <=30MiB; private keys, GitHub/OpenAI/AWS token formats and credential URLs; binary archives not interpreted by this scan.
excluded: complete third-party raw datasets and partial downloads
private submission drafts and temporary work directories
model weights and bulk row predictions from Git history
public_site_build: PASS; built from current docs and sources
github_ci_status: Not evaluated by this local record; see repository Actions.
